_meta.title: huiying Filter Fitment Reference Framework
_meta.purpose: Common-application reference framework for engine air / oil / cabin filters across mainstream passenger vehicles. This is NOT a verified OE cross-reference table.
_meta.disclaimer: Every entry is a common-application reference. No exact OE number, exact dimension, or precise year range is asserted. Always confirm the exact part against the buyer's OE number, cross-reference number, or Huiying's fitment table before ordering.

filters.label: Engine Air Filter
filters.intro: Engine air filters are among the most widely replaced service parts. The brands and models below are common-application references for passenger-car engine air filters across global and domestic Chinese brands.
filters.typical_size_range: Panel type: L 230–350 × W 130–220 × H 25–60 mm (reference range across compact to mid-size cars)
filters.matching_path: Look up the vehicle's OE number → cross-reference to a HY-AF-xxx model by panel dimensions and seal style → confirm with Huiying sales before ordering.

filters.label: Engine Oil Filter
filters.intro: Oil filters are replaced at every engine-oil service. The references below are common-application examples for spin-on and cartridge oil filters across the brands we serve.
filters.typical_size_range: Spin-on / cartridge: OD 60–95 × H 65–140 mm; thread commonly 3/4-16 UNF, M20 or M22 (reference range — confirm per engine)
filters.matching_path: Look up the engine's OE oil-filter number → cross-reference to a HY-OF-xxx model by thread, seal diameter and bypass-valve setting → confirm with Huiying sales.

filters.label: Cabin Air Filter
filters.intro: Cabin (pollen) filters are standard on the majority of modern vehicles. The references below reflect common applications for cabin air filtration across global and domestic Chinese brands.
filters.typical_size_range: Panel type: L 200–320 × W 150–260 × H 15–40 mm (reference range; activated-carbon variants share panel footprint)
filters.matching_path: Look up the vehicle's OE cabin-filter number → cross-reference to a HY-CF-xxx model by frame dimensions and carbon/plain grade → confirm with Huiying sales.
